EXPLORER.name: Explorer
EXPLORER.description: Cycle new roads, visit new neighbourhoods, discover trails, parks and viewpoints, and connect unexplored regions.

WIZARD.name: Wizard
WIZARD.tagline: Hidden knowledge, puzzles and unusual locations.
WIZARD.description: Historical landmarks, strange architecture, ancient sites and puzzle chains.

WARRIOR.name: Warrior
WARRIOR.tagline: Endurance, climbing and a pace you set yourself.
WARRIOR.description: Long distance, demanding terrain, hilltop destinations, and holding a steady pace over a ride — measured against yourself, never a race with other riders.

SCRIBE.name: Scribe
SCRIBE.description: Photograph landmarks, write notes, document trails and record community knowledge.
